descriptions.raw: Warm gold-green crystals that hold captured sunlight within their faceted depths. Heliodor radiates a steady, reassuring glow, as if promising warmth even in the deepest of storms. Valued for its clarity and brightness, it is often set into items meant to inspire trust.
descriptions.cut: A finely cut heliodor, its golden facets blazing with inner warmth. Often chosen for items of ceremony and leadership, it carries the quiet authority of dawn breaking over the plains.
descriptions.sphere: A polished heliodor sphere, warm and luminous. Capable of holding Stormlight, its golden radiance makes it a natural choice for fabrials that strengthen bonds or bolster resolve.
